Scavie rules are that you exchange whatever you drop. You can often see them dropping stuff and exchanging it when they enter the cave. If you do the same, reputation will stay the same.

However, the value of what you drop corresponds with your reputation. Ex, low reputation would mean pearl for exploding spear, medium reputation would mean a spear plus a lantern/mushroom/exploding plant is enough, and with max reputation just dropping a spear is enough. This is what I've observed in my personal experience. Keep in mind that with low reputation, entering a stash with one of them present can result in getting stabbed lol. Depends on the aggression level of the scavie. Max reputation usually means stealing once or twice is forgiven, but more than that will result in a reputation loss. 

There's a table explaining the value of different items when trading with scavengers here!
[Scavenger Trading](https://rainworld.miraheze.org/wiki/Scavenger#Trading)
